text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Prime Minister Hariri: "Israel is waging a psychological war against us".
-Foreign Minister Bouez says that Lebanon can not try the three Iraqi diplomats accused of killing Iraqi opposition leader Taleb Suheil.
-A small bomb exploded near a centre for the pro-Syrian al-Ahbash Moslem fundamentalist faction in south Lebanon; no casualties.
-The General Labour Confederation accused the government of impoverishing the people.

-Employees of Lebanon's national flag carrier Middle East Airlines (MEA) warn of more "escalatory steps" in the future after their 24-hour strike on Tuesday to protest against the company's refusal to meet their pay demands.
-U.N. spokesman Goksel says the size of the UNIFIL peacekeeping force in south Lebanon will not be cut.
